title: We Met!
overview: One day, as she’s still adjusting to her new high school, Kasumi Toyama discovers a trail of stars that leads her to an old thrift store. Inside, she makes a discovery.

title: We Did It!
overview: Kasumi's heart is set on forming a band, but Arisa wants nothing do with it. In fact, Arisa is so determined to avoid her that she puts the star-shaped guitar up for auction.

title: I Ran Away!
overview: Kasumi asks Rimi to join her band, but Rimi is reluctant. Meanwhile, Glitter*Green runs into an issue on the way to their show.

title: I Got Angry!
overview: Kasumi starts staying after school to take guitar lessons from Tae. Meanwhile, Arisa seems to have a problem with all the time they are spending together.

title: My Heart Was Racing!
overview: Kasumi, Tae, and friends are preparing for their first performance. Are they going to be ready in time?

title: I Made It!
overview: Kasumi begins to struggle in school and enlists Saya's help. Meanwhile, Arisa has been searching for the perfect band name.

title: We Fought!
overview: Kasumi has a tall order in convincing Saya to join Poppin Party, is she able to do it? Meanwhile, they continue to get ready for the Culture Festival!

title: I Ran!
overview: The Cultural Festival preparations are done, and it is time for it to begin. Meanwhile, Poppin' Party play their first show! How does it go?

title: I Got a Job!
overview: Saya gets a new drum set and the girls all get jobs at Space! They learn what goes into putting on a live show.

title: I Was Surprised!
overview: Poppin' Party auditions at Space but to play there you must impress the owner. Do they achieve their dream?

title: I Couldn't Sing Anymore
overview: Kasumi is still struggling to find her voice but the rest of Poppin' Party is there to help pick her up.

title: I Sparkled?!
overview: Poppin' Party gets another chance to play at Space. Will they finally impress the owner?

title: We Sang!
overview: Kasumi finally achieves her dream as Poppin' Party plays at Space's last show. How will they perform?
